title: Lane Twelve
hook: If the pins on lane twelve ever set themselves up after closing... don't bowl.
lines: I close up an old bowling alley at the edge of town. Alone. Every night.
The owner, Mr. Briggs, gave me one rule on my first shift.
If the pins on lane twelve ever set themselves up after closing... don't bowl. Just kill the lights, and leave.
For a whole month... nothing happened.
Then one night, while I was mopping, the machine on lane twelve hummed to life.
Ten white pins dropped into place... standing perfectly still in the dark.
The little score screen above the lane blinked on. One player. The name just said... NEXT.
I didn't bowl. I didn't look back. I just left.
The next night, the screen had two players. NEXT... and Briggs.
Mr. Briggs didn't come in the next morning. Or the morning after that.
Tonight, when I unlocked the doors, the pins on twelve were already standing.
And the ball return rumbled... and slowly rolled a ball up to my hand. Still warm.
